summary.text: Julia Curran is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 140, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired registered nurse with more than 35 years of experience, she lives in Christian County and also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Julia Curran graduated from Moore Catholic High School, and from Staten Island Community College and the Saint Vincent's School of Nursing in 1985.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Curran said she worked as a registered nurse for more than 35 years in leadership, advocacy and teaching roles.
She said she and her husband moved their family to Missouri more than 20 years ago and settled in Christian County.
Ray Gragg defeated Curran in the general election for Missouri House District 140 on November 5, 2024.
In the 2026 survey, Curran said her campaign would focus on rising costs, a stable economy and a balanced state budget, and on supporting public schools and teacher pay.
